name: UK SDR — Sustainability Disclosure Requirements
description: UK FCA fund labelling and disclosure regime for sustainability products. Four labels per PS23/16.

sustainabilityFocus.label: Sustainability Focus
sustainabilityFocus.description: Invests mainly in assets that are environmentally or socially sustainable (≥70% sustainable assets per PS23/16 9.10(1))

sustainabilityImprovers.label: Sustainability Improvers
sustainabilityImprovers.description: Invests in assets with potential to improve their sustainability profile over time (per PS23/16 9.30)

sustainabilityImpact.label: Sustainability Impact
sustainabilityImpact.description: Aims to achieve a pre-defined, positive, measurable impact (per PS23/16 9.40)

sustainabilityMixedGoals.label: Sustainability Mixed Goals
sustainabilityMixedGoals.description: Where a fund's objective aligns with more than one of the other labels' standards for different parts of the portfolio (per PS23/16 9.50)
sustainabilityMixedGoals.citation: FCA PS23/16, ESG 5.3.5R — Sustainability Mixed Goals

crossCuttingRules.antiGreenwashing: Anti-greenwashing rule ESG 4.3.1R — sustainability-related claims about products and services must be fair, clear, and not misleading
crossCuttingRules.namingAndMarketing: Naming & marketing rules ESG 4.3.2R–4.3.14R — restrictions on use of sustainability-related terms in product names and marketing

disclosureRequirements.preContractual: Sustainability label, sustainability objectives, investment policy and strategy, KPIs
disclosureRequirements.ongoing: Annual sustainability report with KPI tracking against stated objectives
disclosureRequirements.naming: Unlabelled funds may not use sustainability-related terms in names or marketing (ESG 4.3.2R–4.3.14R)
